title: China Blocks 10 Apps You Use Daily — the 2026 Fix | China Travel Expert
description:
China blocks about 10 of the apps you use every day — Google, Gmail, Maps, YouTube, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, X, Telegram and Snapchat all go dark on a local Chinese network. Here's how tourists actually stay connected in 2026.

The key detail most guides get wrong: a *local* Chinese SIM sits behind the Great Firewall, so switching to one does NOT unblock those apps. An *international roaming* eSIM keeps your phone's data on a foreign network, so your traffic leaves China and the blocked apps usually load normally. The catch: hotel and cafe Wi-Fi are local Chinese networks — still firewalled — so install a VPN before you fly as a backup for Wi-Fi and your laptop.

🧭 Expert Tip: Set up your roaming eSIM AND download a VPN before you land — you can't reach most VPN or app-store download pages once you're inside the firewall.

来中国前先装好:漫游eSIM让手机数据走境外网络,常用App基本能用;但酒店WiFi仍在墙内,记得备一个VPN。
